answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, expired if not renewed by fresh work, rewards vest against future work. Each submission hangs on the marble of a task receipt, and the velvet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. By the jetty of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
